title: 统计特殊四元组
summary: 统计下标 a<b<c<d 且 nums[a]+nums[b]+nums[c]=nums[d] 的四元组数量。
insight: 数组最多五十，直接按严格下标顺序枚举四个位置，清晰且足够快。

solutions.title: 四下标直接枚举
solutions.idea: 按顺序枚举所有合法下标组合并检查等式。

code.java: class Solution { public int countQuadruplets(int[] nums){int answer=0,n=nums.length;for(int a=0;a<n;a++)for(int b=a+1;b<n;b++)for(int c=b+1;c<n;c++)for(int d=c+1;d<n;d++)if(nums[a]+nums[b]+nums[c]==nums[d])answer++;return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun countQuadruplets(nums:IntArray):Int{var answer=0;for(a in nums.indices)for(b in a+1 until nums.size)for(c in b+1 until nums.size)for(d in c+1 until nums.size)if(nums[a]+nums[b]+nums[c]==nums[d])answer++;return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int countQuadruplets(vector<int>& nums){int answer=0,n=nums.size();for(int a=0;a<n;++a)for(int b=a+1;b<n;++b)for(int c=b+1;c<n;++c)for(int d=c+1;d<n;++d)answer+=nums[a]+nums[b]+nums[c]==nums[d];return answer;} };
